offersPage.title: BetInsight – Buy Units
offersPage.heading: Available Offers
offersPage.intro: Choose an available offer. After secure reservation, you receive the exact frozen USDT amount and the seller wallet assigned to this booking on TRON.
offersPage.pilot: PILOT LIVE – real payment flow. After a single confirmation, BetInsight automatically checks the blockchain at 0 / 25 / 50 / 75 / 120 seconds.
offersPage.demo: Preview with test offers – no real purchase will be triggered.
offersPage.loadingCopy: One moment please. Available Units are being checked.
offersPage.emptyCopy: There are currently no Units available for purchase.
offersPage.errorCopy: Please check your connection and try again.
offersPage.reservationCheck: Reservation and payment details are being checked server-side.
offersPage.timerCopy: This offer is reserved exclusively for you during the countdown.
offersPage.checkPayment: Check the amount and wallet character by character in your own wallet app once more.
offersPage.pay1: Send exactly the displayed USDT amount.
offersPage.pay3: Recipient: only the seller wallet shown above.
offersPage.pay4: After the transaction is confirmed, paste the 64-character TXID below.
offersPage.txidCopy: One click is enough. The backend verifies TXID, USDT token, recipient, exact amount, blockchain time window, TXID lock and transfer lock. If blockchain confirmation is not available yet, it rechecks automatically.
offersPage.autoCheck: Automatic checks: immediately, after 25 s, 50 s, 75 s and 120 s. While waiting, you will see a countdown until the next check. Keep the page open. A TXID can only be processed once server-side.
offersPage.importantCopy: Gift Units are excluded from sales. Payment approval applies only to the specific BIK, the frozen amount and the seller wallet stored in it. Any mismatch keeps the transfer locked.
offersPage.accessMissing: No valid dashboard access detected. Please open the Unit Exchange from your profile.
offersPage.windowEndedChecking: Payment window ended – blockchain check running
offersPage.windowEndedRetry: Payment window ended – TXID recheck available
offersPage.noMorePayment: Do not send another payment. A TXID already submitted can continue to be checked during the security grace period.
offersPage.expiredCopy: The payment window has ended. Do not send a new payment.
offersPage.visibleWindowEnded: The visible payment window has ended.
offersPage.invalidPaymentJson: The PILOT payment endpoint returned no valid JSON response.
offersPage.paymentPrepareFailed: Payment details could not be prepared.
offersPage.securityStop: Security stop: Payment details are incomplete or not approved.
offersPage.noBooking: No valid booking number is available.
offersPage.reservedSub: Offer {{id}} was assigned to your account server-side. Amount and seller wallet are confirmed for this BIK.
offersPage.paymentNotConfirmed: Payment details could not be securely confirmed.
offersPage.statusReadFailed: Purchase status could not be read.
offersPage.noActiveWindow: The reservation has no active server-side time window.
offersPage.demoNoReservation: Preview: no reservation will be triggered.
offersPage.reservedLoaded: Offer reserved. Payment details loaded securely.
offersPage.reservedBlocked: Offer reserved. Payment remains blocked for security reasons.
offersPage.selfBlocked: You cannot buy your own sale offer.
offersPage.unavailable: This offer is no longer available.
offersPage.reservationNotConfirmed: The reservation could not be confirmed yet.
offersPage.finalizerInvalid: The finalizer returned no valid JSON response.
offersPage.transferComplete: Payment confirmed and Unit transfer completed.
offersPage.transferSub: The booking was finalized server-side. A second transfer with the same BIK/TXID is blocked.
offersPage.nextCheck: {{prefix}}Next check {{next}} of {{total}} in {{sec}} {{seconds}}. Do not pay again and keep the page open.
offersPage.txid64: The TXID must contain exactly 64 hexadecimal characters.
offersPage.paymentWindowExpired: The visible payment window has expired. Do not send another payment.
offersPage.graceEnded: The security grace period for this booking has ended. Nothing was booked twice.
offersPage.checkRunning: Check {{current}} of {{total}} is running … Blockchain confirmation is being verified. Keep the page open.
offersPage.fiveDoneRetry: 5 automatic checks completed. Blockchain confirmation is not available yet. Nothing was booked twice. Click “Check Again” to start another automatic check round.
offersPage.fiveDoneEnded: The security grace period has now ended. Nothing was booked twice. Please contact Support with the BIK and TXID.
offersPage.tempCheckError: The blockchain check could not be completed temporarily. Nothing was booked twice. You can restart the automatic check.
offersPage.checkEndedSupport: The blockchain check could not be completed and the security grace period has ended. Please contact Support with the BIK and TXID.
offersPage.copyFailed: Copying failed. Please select and copy manually.
